name: Reynolds Ranch
summary: Reynolds Ranch is a 200-plus acre master-planned lifestyle community in Lodi wine country, featuring shopping, dining, luxury apartments, and new homes. This modern mixed-use destination combines retail convenience with upscale residential living, offering residents and visitors a comprehensive shop-live-work environment.
demographics: Reynolds Ranch attracts a diverse demographic mix of young professionals, growing families, and active retirees drawn to Lodi's wine country lifestyle. The primary trade area serves middle to upper-middle income households with annual incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, reflecting the community's master-planned residential component and luxury apartment offerings. Visitors typically include local residents seeking convenient shopping and dining options, as well as wine country tourists exploring the Lodi region. The center appeals to lifestyle-oriented consumers who value a mix of retail, dining, and residential amenities in a modern, walkable environment.
description: Reynolds Ranch is a distinctive 200-plus acre master-planned community nestled in the heart of Lodi wine country, offering a unique blend of shopping, dining, residential living, and services. This modern lifestyle destination features the Rubicon at Reynolds Ranch luxury apartment community, which provides residents with elegant amenities including poolside cabanas, bocce ball courts, and contemporary living spaces that embody the "Live the Difference" philosophy. The center serves as Lodi's most prestigious address, combining retail convenience with upscale residential options in a thoughtfully designed environment. Located at 2960 Reynolds Ranch Parkway, the development represents a comprehensive approach to mixed-use planning, where residents can truly shop, live, and work within a single cohesive community. With its strategic location in California's renowned wine country and its focus on quality amenities, Reynolds Ranch has established itself as a premier destination for both locals and visitors seeking an elevated lifestyle experience in the Lodi area.
